architectural_fidelity.reason: Cova added dramatic curved archway structures to walls and ceiling that do not exist in the original flat-walled room; window position maintained but entirely wrong architectural geometry

furniture_removal.reason: All original furniture completely removed with no ghost outlines or remnants visible

style_commitment.reason: Strong Japandi execution with wabi-sabi curved plaster walls, natural oak furniture, woven pendant lights, minimal linen bedding, and serene neutral palette—unmistakably committed to style

editorial_density.reason: Multiple pendant lights, sculptural branch element, textured textiles, and nightstand styling present, but lacks wall art, layered accessories, and additional vignettes for true AD-level density

photorealism.reason: Sophisticated lighting with natural shadows, realistic linen texture, accurate wood grain, and cohesive ambient glow—no plastic CGI feel

designer_preference_reason: Despite Cova's superior style execution, the invented curved architecture fundamentally misrepresents the client's actual space, making it unusable for real staging purposes.
what_cova_does_better: Dramatically stronger and more sophisticated style commitment to Japandi aesthetic
Superior photorealism with nuanced lighting and material rendering
More interesting design with sculptural elements and curated minimalism
Better ambient atmosphere and mood creation
what_collov_does_better: Maintains accurate architectural integrity of the original room
Preserves actual wall geometry and ceiling structure
Keeps the DAKSH lettering as existing architectural feature
Provides realistic staging client could actually implement
specific_fixes_if_failing: Remove all invented curved archway structures and restore flat walls matching original
Maintain standard ceiling height without dramatic vault modifications
Preserve architectural accuracy while applying Japandi style to furnishings and finishes only
Add more editorial accessories: wall art, books, decorative objects, additional plants for density
